result.instructions: Tools for Short.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the short link at go.example.com/spring-sale and show where it points."; "Create a short link for our spring sale page with the path spring-sale."; "Update the destination of the link at /pricing to the new pricing page.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Short.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shortio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shortio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shortio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shortio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shortio_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the custom domains of the account behind the API key, with their ids. Good first call: the domain id is needed by the link tools. Short.io API: GET /api/domains.

pattern.description: Filter domains whose name contains this text.

tools.name: shortio_get_domain
tools.title: Get a domain
tools.description: Get one domain's details and settings by its numeric id. Short.io API: GET /domains/{domainId}.

tools.name: shortio_list_links
tools.title: List links
tools.description: List short links of one domain, with pagination. Pass the nextPageToken from the previous response as page_token to get the next page. Short.io API: GET /api/links.

limit.description: Links per page (the API accepts less than 150).

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous response; sent as pageToken.

folder_id.description: Only links in this folder id.

id_string.description: Only links whose id string matches this value.

created_after.description: Only links created after this date (as the API documents it).

created_before.description: Only links created before this date (as the API documents it).

tools.name: shortio_get_link
tools.title: Get a link
tools.description: Get one short link by its link id, including its original URL, path, tags and click settings. Short.io API: GET /links/{linkId}.

domain_id.description: Domain id that owns the link (recommended).

tools.name: shortio_get_link_by_path
tools.title: Get a link by path
tools.description: Find one short link by its domain and path (the part after the slash, such as 'spring-sale'). Short.io API: GET /links/expand.

domain.description: The short domain name, for example go.example.com.

path.description: The link path, without the domain or slash.

tools.name: shortio_create_link
tools.title: Create a link
tools.description: Create a new public short link on one domain. Without a path, the API picks one. Same path with a different URL returns HTTP 409. Short.io API: POST /links.

domain.description: The short domain name, for example go.example.com.

original_url.description: The long URL to redirect to.

path.description: Custom path (slug). Omit to let the API choose.

folder_id.description: Folder id to place the link in.

allow_duplicates.description: Allow a second link to the same URL.

tools.name: shortio_update_link
tools.title: Update a link
tools.description: Change the destination URL, title, path or tags of an existing link. Changing the path changes the live short URL. Short.io API: POST /links/{linkId}.

domain_id.description: Domain id that owns the link.

path.description: New path. Changing it breaks the old short URL.

tools.name: shortio_archive_link
tools.title: Archive a link
tools.description: Hide a link from the Short.io dashboard. An archived link still redirects. Reversible with shortio_unarchive_link. Short.io API: POST /links/archive.

domain_id.description: Domain id that owns the link.

tools.name: shortio_unarchive_link
tools.title: Unarchive a link
tools.description: Show an archived link in the Short.io dashboard again. Short.io API: POST /links/unarchive.

domain_id.description: Domain id that owns the link.
